# Ankate Consulting Ltd

> HR consultancy in Ruiru, Kenya. Recruitment, payroll and HR administration, compliance advisory, training and performance, outsourced HR and HR policies for growing organisations in Kenya. Founded and led by CHRP AnnMary Kananu, a Certified Human Resource Professional with 10+ years of experience and a registered member of IHRM Kenya. Serves organisations across all of Kenya.

## Pages
- [Ankate Consulting](https://www.ankateconsulting.co.ke/): Ankate Consulting provides practical HR consulting, recruitment, payroll, compliance, training and outsourced HR for growing organisations in Kenya.
- [HR Services in Kenya](https://www.ankateconsulting.co.ke/services.html): Six HR services for Kenyan organisations: compliance, recruitment, payroll and HR administration, training and performance, outsourced HR and HR policies.
- [HR Compliance & Workplace Advisory in Kenya](https://www.ankateconsulting.co.ke/services/compliance.html): Practical guidance on employment documentation, employee relations and Kenyan workplace requirements, so leaders can manage people with confidence and fewer avoidable disputes.
- [Recruitment & Talent Acquisition in Kenya](https://www.ankateconsulting.co.ke/services/recruitment.html): Structured recruitment support from defining the role through sourcing, assessment and onboarding, so hiring decisions rest on evidence rather than guesswork.
- [Payroll & HR Administration in Kenya](https://www.ankateconsulting.co.ke/services/payroll.html): Payroll and HR administration support for Kenyan businesses, including employee records and statutory deductions, so the work behind the workforce runs without interruption.
- [Training & Performance Management in Kenya](https://www.ankateconsulting.co.ke/services/performance.html): Training and performance systems that give managers and employees a shared understanding of what good looks like, and the skills to deliver it.
- [Outsourced HR Solutions in Kenya](https://www.ankateconsulting.co.ke/services/outsourced-hr.html): Extend your HR capability with flexible support that scales with your organisation, from a few selected tasks to a fully managed HR function.
- [HR Policies & Business Support in Kenya](https://www.ankateconsulting.co.ke/services/policies.html): Policies, handbooks, contracts and procedures written for how your organisation actually works, so expectations are clear for managers and employees alike.

- [HR and AI in the Modern Workplace](https://www.ankateconsulting.co.ke/insights/hr-and-ai.html): How AI is changing recruitment, engagement and HR administration, and why human judgement stays essential in the modern workplace.
